enacted constitutional reform during the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The source identifies the enacted constitutional measure but does not state Lula's personal role beyond its occurrence under his administration.","limitations":["The document does not provide implementation, fiscal-incidence, or outcome evidence."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6713ccc1726a1cdf","start_unit":12,"end_unit":12,"fact_summary":"A Senate technical study assessed the Executive's proposed new fiscal framework as a potentially useful starting point for permanent fiscal rules, but found that it lacked a substantive result independent of ordinary budget decisions and excluded major components of public finances, making final debt and macroeconomic outcomes indeterminate.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.7","8B.6","8B.8"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"2023; evaluates PL 93/2023 during the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The proposal was from Lula's Executive, while the adverse assessment was made by a Senate technical study.","limitations":["The source evaluates a proposal rather than fully executed policy.","It does not establish whether the identified design problems were later corrected."]},{"source_id":"SRC-6cc633781990d3a5","start_unit":11,"end_unit":11,"fact_summary":"In Brazil's August 2023 statement to the NPT Preparatory Committee, the delegation supported nuclear-weapon-free zones and called for legally binding, universal, unconditional, and multilateral negative security assurances as a disarmament and security measure.","question_ids":["1B.1","1B.2","1B.4","1B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"2023; official diplomatic position stated during the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The statement was delivered by Brazil's delegation under Lula's government; it does not identify a personal presidential directive.","limitations":["The statement records diplomatic advocacy, not ratification, implementation, funding, or measurable risk reduction."]},{"source_id":"SRC-0ba966b9a99febc0","start_unit":11,"end_unit":11,"fact_summary":"Brazil supported UN-facilitated mediation and an inclusive Libyan-led political process, welcomed agreement on electoral laws, encouraged peacebuilding and reconciliation, warned that military training could breach the UN arms embargo, and urged protection of refugees' and migrants' human rights.","question_ids":["2B.5","2B.7","2B.10","3B.7"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"2023; official June 2023 statement.","ruler_attribution":"The position was expressed by Brazil's delegation under Lula's administration; it is not evidence of Lula's personal action.","limitations":["The source documents diplomatic positions rather than policy implementation or outcomes in Libya."]},{"source_id":"SRC-377134e7defd6f3a","start_unit":14,"end_unit":17,"fact_summary":"Brazil's 2023 personal-income-tax schedule established monthly brackets from exemption up to 27.5%; from May 2023 it raised the monthly tax-free threshold to R$2,112, with a R$528 simplified deduction limit, while annual rules applied to calendar-year 2023 income.","question_ids":["5B.3","5B.8"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"2023; tax rules applied during the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The source records rules administered by the federal government but does not identify Lula's personal decision or the distributional incidence.","limitations":["No revenue, compliance, poverty, or distributional outcome is reported."]},{"source_id":"SRC-eed1733212a2f6f5","start_unit":9,"end_unit":12,"fact_summary":"In 2023, Decrees 11.630, 11.631, and 11.632 created Novo PAC's interministerial innovation and procurement commission, professional qualification and inclusion commission, and program and management committee; a December resolution later specified the program's actions and mandatory-transfer actions.","question_ids":["5B.6","6B.2","6B.9","8B.1","8B.2","8B.3","8B.5","8B.6"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"2023; legal and institutional creation occurred during the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The measures were issued by the federal Executive under Lula's administration.","limitations":["The source does not report executed spending, completed projects, service delivery, or outcomes."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3f4f061a0a7cd580","start_unit":5,"end_unit":6,"fact_summary":"The World Bank reported that Bolsa Família benefited nearly 47 million people from 2011 to 2021, including nearly 24 million women, and was associated with a 58% decline in extreme poverty and a 41% reduction in inequality; 94% of funds reached the poorest 40%, and women comprised about 89% of direct recipients.","question_ids":["6B.2","6B.3","6B.10"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"Historical evidence spanning 2011-2021; not specific to 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source describes the program's cumulative historical performance and does not attribute the outcomes specifically to Lula's 2023 administration.","limitations":["The period predates 2023 and includes multiple administrations.","The source does not establish 2023 continuation, changes, or causal attribution to Lula."]},{"source_id":"SRC-8cde8dbacc61eb7d","start_unit":8,"end_unit":11,"fact_summary":"In January 2023, the government explained that corporate-card information for completed presidential mandates had been published after a TCU decision required active transparency; Lula's decree ordered CGU to review approximately 2,000 appealed secrecy decisions within 30 days using general criteria for personal-data and legally protected information, out of about 65,000 restricted requests.","question_ids":["4B.6","4B.9","7B.2","7B.6","7B.7","8B.8"],"polarity":"favorable","period_fit":"January 2023; directly within the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The interview describes actions ordered by President Lula and implemented through CGU.","limitations":["The source reports the announced review process, not its completed findings or remedies.","The interview is an official government account."]},{"source_id":"SRC-e8650c7cedf30924","start_unit":19,"end_unit":20,"fact_summary":"A CNJ census and STF/CNJ statements in October 2023 characterized Brazil's prison system as a mass, unconstitutional violation of rights; among about 650,000 prisoners, 57% had not completed primary education, while more than 250,000 people had received sentence remission through reading, up from 46,000 in prior years.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.4","3B.6","3B.10","6B.2","6B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"October 2023; institutional findings during the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The findings concern Brazil's state prison system but do not attribute responsibility or corrective action specifically to Lula.","limitations":["The source does not establish federal presidential control over the cited deficiencies or quantify Lula-era change.","The reading-remission result reflects judicial and prison-system initiatives, not necessarily presidential action."]},{"source_id":"SRC-00de299233c43312","start_unit":12,"end_unit":14,"fact_summary":"After the January 8 attacks, Lula publicly described the intelligence failure as an elementary error, called the attacks the beginning of a coup attempt, promised punishment regardless of rank, rejected a proposed federal military intervention under GLO, and stated that a new public-security ministry and stronger border and environmental enforcement would be pursued.","question_ids":["3B.2","3B.9","3B.10","4B.10","8B.8","8B.9"],"polarity":"mixed","period_fit":"January 2023; crisis response within the target period.","ruler_attribution":"The reported statements and decisions are attributed directly to President Lula.","limitations":["The source reports rhetoric and announced intentions, not the subsequent completion or effectiveness of all promised institutional changes.","The intelligence failure described may have been inherited, but the article does not independently establish responsibility."]}],"documents_with_no_material_fact":["SRC-19d9202b93ff8c18","SRC-1a19ab1c1451db9d"],"batch_limitations":["Several sources concern institutional or diplomatic positions under Lula's government rather than actions personally documented as directed by Lula.","The supplied documents provide limited evidence of completed implementation and outcomes for policies enacted in 2023."]}
